symptom: An active Pi tool row looks identical to a completed static row, so the user cannot tell whether it is working or stuck without opening details.

observation_packet.user_action: ask Pi to perform work and watch the visible tool summary
observation_packet.expected: the currently executing tool has an obvious lightweight motion cue that stops on completion
observation_packet.actual: the visible tool summary is static and visually identical before and after its result
observation_packet.network_ws: Pi emits tool_execution_start and tool_execution_end through the existing renderer event stream
observation_packet.computed_style_layout: animation-name is none; class is always pi-tool-line
observation_packet.state_store_snapshot: tool start appends a tool segment without output; tool result adds the output property while the assistant turn remains streaming

hypotheses.hypothesis: The transcript has enough truthful state but never projects it into an active tool class
hypotheses.would_disprove: an unfinished tool already receives a distinct class or active animation
hypotheses.result: confirmed: PiAssistantSegments ignores streaming/output state for tool rows

breakpoint: Resolved by projecting unfinished/result state into the shared WmbCreatureMark working/settling/idle states.
owner_check: Packaged live tool showed animated W body/pupil without opening details, settled on the real result, and remained static afterward.
last_gate: 8/8 focused tests, typecheck, Harness, package and live packaged working/settling/idle DOM readback passed
